title: NKD per-slot intraday gate causality — the gate required bars from the future

safety.window_open_during_stage: global_nkd 01:10-02:55 ET — open for most of it, NOT disturbed

root_cause: a grid-quantised frame compared against a continuous instant, in two places
where_the_codes_came_from: run_live_day_track1 builds the ledger detail as ','.join(verdict.codes) from intra.validate and nothing else — so both codes were the INTRADAY gate, not the SPY freshness gate
the_wrong_story_ruled_out: three slots ran AFTER the CSV was refreshed to 2026-08-24 and still said partial_coverage,stale, and freshness.evaluate() returned allow=True by then

bugs.cause: _span_check demanded bars to req.today_to = 15:55 for EVERY slot, so a 14:10 slot required 105 minutes that had not happened
bugs.measured: today_span partial_coverage — 'last bar in the span is 15:46, expected 15:55' on a frame holding 107 contiguous bars of the session

bugs.cause: the staleness horizon was raw `now`. A slot fires ~3s after its minute, so the newest complete 5-minute bucket is exactly one bar back and `last + 5min < now` was true by those seconds
bugs.measured: staleness stale — 'last bar 15:45 is more than one 5-minute bar behind 15:50:03'

fix.helper: _last_closed_bar(now, n) = floor(now, n) - n — the newest grid point whose bar must certainly have finished
fix.why_flooring_alone_is_not_enough: at 14:10:03 the 14:10 bar is the one still open; Stage 5R-0 drops it for exactly that reason
fix.used_twice: the span high bound and the staleness horizon, so the two cannot disagree about which bar the frame owes; a test parses validate and requires exactly two call sites

span_bound_is_per_sleeve.why_not_blanket: a blanket min() would have shrunk Calm's span from 09:30-10:00 to 09:30-09:55 at 10:00:03 and stopped demanding the 10:00 bar in the span

fix.swing_also_fixed: measurement, not assumption — its today_to is the same end-of-band shape; its 14:00 low bound is untouched
nothing_widened: a frame two bars behind still refuses stale

progression.meaning: span fix live, staleness fix not yet
both live; only the benign end-of-band refusal

too_late_is_not_a_third_bug.what: the final slot fires ~3s after decide_to and can never decide
too_late_is_not_a_third_bug.benign_because: the acceptance gate classifies too_late as observed_window_shut, an OBSERVED class, so it cannot make a window incomplete
too_late_is_not_a_third_bug.contrast: partial_coverage,stale classified as observed_hard_refusal — which is why the other nineteen mattered

proofs.1_frame_ending_at_slot_passes: five slot times plus a walk of all 21 decidable slots
proofs.3_hole_still_refuses: gap_in_coverage; a late start still partial_coverage
proofs.4_stale_still_fires: 1/2/6 bars behind — one back is NOT stale, two is
proofs.6_live_ledger_explained_and_untouched: a test reads the real ledger and asserts every refusal is one of the two codes, decided=False, nothing edited
proofs.7_artifact_reproduction_unchanged: Stage 4 three-window run (TRACK1_STAGE4_ALL=1): 32 passed in 16m01s — Normal-R4 incl. MNKD 1,223/1,223, Calm A 421/421, Stress-MNQ 50/3/4
proofs.8_orders_impossible: B1 and PAPER_SHADOW_EVIDENCE both blocking; no confirmation file; env unset; no --allow-orders

mutations.note: most do not remove the fix, they OVERSHOOT it — the danger with a causality fix is that it widens something

detail.mutation: the LOW bound follows the slot too
staleness reaches back a whole day
the horizon uses raw now again
Calm dragged into the dynamic bound
the NKD requirement validated on ET
too_late removed from the clock refusal codes

this_window_will_not_pass.why: nineteen slots were hard-refused by the old code before the fix landed
this_window_will_not_pass.next_judgeable: 2026-08-26 01:10 ET — the first NKD window on the fixed gate
this_window_will_not_pass.watch_there: spy_refresh_pm fires for the first time today at 16:20 ET, so Wednesday's freshness should pass — a different gate from this one, and not yet observed working

tests_repaired.why: a stale 'B1 is the only blocker' literal — the eighth and last copy, left over from before Stage 5S added PAPER_SHADOW_EVIDENCE; not caused by this stage

regression.note: the gate change touches what a slot is ALLOWED to decide on, not what the sleeves compute, so the reproduction was the check that mattered most — and the committed rows are unmoved
